title: Post Malone Is Engaged to Christy Lee
summary: Malone and Lee were first linked in early 2025.
contentText:
Post Malone and Christy Lee are engaged after rekindling their relationship, People has confirmed.

On Wednesday (Aug. 19), Lee’s friend Marina Hollyer posted the news on Instagram Stories , sharing a photo of the couple with the caption “My best friend in the world just got engaged.”

TMZ was first to report the news. Billboard has reached out to Malone’s publicist for confirmation.

Related

Post Malone Teases Return to Hip-Hop: ‘That One Mofo That Don’t Know When to Leave’

According to TMZ , Malone proposed to Lee on Tuesday in Utah, where friends also flew out to celebrate the occasion.

Malone and Lee were first linked in early 2025, when they were spotted together during a dinner outing in Rome. By March of that year, the pair had been photographed showing PDA, and they were later spotted together in Paris. People also reported on their April 2025 dinner date in Paris, where the two were photographed walking hand-in-hand after their meal.

However, TMZ reported in June 2025 that Malone and Lee had called it quits after several months of dating. The outlet reported at the time that the couple had separated nearly a month earlier.

It’s unclear exactly when Malone and Lee reconciled, though the pair were photographed together at the Khaite fashion show in New York in February 2026 , including in the picture above.

Lee’s relationship with Malone began not long after the singer ended his previous engagement to Hee Sung “Jamie” Park, the mother of his daughter. He confirmed the engagement in 2022 after proposing during a trip to Las Vegas, and the couple welcomed their daughter that same year.

People reported in April 2025 that Malone and Park had seemingly split by early 2025, shortly before Malone began appearing publicly with Lee.

Neither Malone nor Lee has publicly confirmed the reported engagement at the time of publication.
